match_details.gold_answer: The latest French Open men's singles champion is Carlos Alcaraz. He won the 2025 French Open, defending his title by defeating world No. 1 Jannik Sinner in the final, which lasted five hours and twenty nine minutes — the longest final in the tournament's history. This victory was confirmed across multiple sources, including the official 2025 French Open page and older Wikipedia revisions that list Alcaraz as the current champion. The 2026 French Open, which began on 24 May 2026, saw Alcaraz withdraw before the tournament started due to a wrist injury, meaning he will not defend his title this year.
